title: Turkish-Style Lahmacun
description: A traditional Turkish dish, similar to a pizza but topped with spiced minced lamb and onions. This recipe makes one large lahmacun, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
2. Gradually add the water, mixing until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
6. Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
7. Place the dough on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
8. In a small bowl, mix together the lamb, onion, garlic, paprika, and black pepper.
9. Spread the lamb mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
10. Drizzle the lemon juice over the lamb mixture.
11. Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling to create a crust.
12. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the crust is golden brown.
